title: Honeybee head: proteins and RNA

views.name: Proteomics
views.unit: log2 abundance; median of mapped proteins per gene

source.access: Author-provided study files selected by Huan Zhong for BIOC557 teaching. Only the published exposed t2 HBB/CRA cohort is included.
source.excluded: All unexposed controls, other time points, other crops, QXB experiments and adjusted/residualized expression tables are excluded.
source.matching: Explicit protein_rna_meta.txt crosswalk. RNA filename token must uniquely match the crosswalk RNA label. No matching by row order.
source.unit: Apiary-year pooled tissue sample. Twelve dissected bees per pool in the published design. Analyze one tissue at a time; three tissue pools from the same apiary-year are not independent apiary replicates.

papers.title: Omics Insights Into the Effects of Highbush Blueberry and Cranberry Crop Agroecosystems on Honey Bee Health and Physiology

processing: Keep exactly the 60 exposed t2 tissue pools from the explicit protein/RNA crosswalk, then analyze one tissue at a time (20 samples, 10 per crop).
Protein: nonpositive source abundance becomes missing before log2; aggregate exact RefSeq-to-gene mappings by median of observed log2 protein values within each gene.

RNA: remove HTSeq auxiliary __ rows; TMM normalization uses all assigned gene counts within the selected tissue. Sum exact gene aliases, then log2(TMM CPM+1). Keep genes with CPM>=1 in at least half the tissue samples.

Keep features observed in at least half the tissue samples and with nonzero variance, then at most 1200 per view ranked by variance without crop labels. The model applies its own subsequent missingness/feature filter.

Do not use the removeTissue/removeYear residualized tables, significance-filtered results, or source-imputed protein matrices. This is a new MOFA teaching analysis, not a reproduction of the paper WGCNA.

pairing_unit: Exact apiary-year and tissue pool matched by the author’s protein/RNA crosswalk. Twelve bees per published tissue pool; a pool is one replicate.

teaching.description: HBB/CRA field study. Head: 10 blueberry and 10 cranberry apiary-year pools, sampled in 2020 and 2021.
teaching.warning: 20 matched apiary-year pools per tissue, sampled in 2020–2021. Compare crop, year, province and MS plate on the factor-association page.
